title: Title
send_advert: To use this service, you need to log into your account. If you are not authorized, please register. After successful login, you will be able to post ads. On the main page with ads, find the "Create ad" button in the form of a "plus" sign, which will direct you to the ad creation page. Follow the instructions, and your ad will be successfully published.
delete_advert: To use this service, please go to "my account", which is located at the bottom of the navigation menu. Here you will find all your ads, next to each of them will be an icon "three dots". Clicking on this icon, you will have the opportunity to either delete the ad or make changes.
change_password_question: What to do if you forgot your password?
forgot_pass: If you have forgotten your account password, do not worry. Go to the authorization section, where you will see the option "Forgot password?". By clicking on it, you will be redirected to the password recovery page. Enter the email address associated with your account. Instructions for further password recovery will be sent to this address.
change_email_question: How to change the language of the application?
change_language:
To change the language of the application, you have three options: 
1) On the main page 
2) On the authorization page 
3) On the profile page
share_advert: To share an ad, you need to find the ad you are interested in and click on the "share" icon in the form of an arrow, which is located in the upper right corner of the ad. After that, you can share the ad on social networks or send a link to the ad in a message.
send_seller: To establish contact with the seller, you should find the ad you are interested in and select the option "Write". After that, you will be automatically redirected to the chat page, where you can send a message to the seller.
chat_helper_question: What is the ChatHelper for on the chat page?
chat_helper: ChatHelper is a support service that helps you solve problems. If you have any questions related to the operation of the application, you can contact ChatHelper, which will help you solve the problem.
do_filter_question: How to use filters to search for ads?
do_filter: To use filters, you need to click on the "filter" icon, which is located under the search. After that, you can select the necessary parameters for searching for ads. After selecting the parameters, click on the "Apply" button, and you will be shown ads that match your criteria.
edit_data_question: How to change data in the profile?
edit_data: To change data in the profile, you need to go to "my account", which is located at the bottom of the navigation menu. Here you will find all your data, which you can change. After making changes, don't forget to click the "Save" button.
rating_seller_question: How to view the seller's rating?
rating_seller: To view the seller's rating, you need to find the ad you are interested in and click on the seller's name. After that, you will be redirected to the seller's profile page, where you can see his rating and reviews about him.
security_data: Yes, your data is securely protected. We use the most modern technologies to protect your data. All the data you provide is stored in encrypted form
guide_home: On the home page you see all ads. Use the search field to find an ad by keyword. Below the search is a category carousel — click a category (real estate, transport, electronics, etc.) to see only ads from that category. The "Popular searches" block offers quick links to popular searches. Click the "Filters" button to select country, region, price and other parameters. Ads load automatically as you scroll.
guide_categories: When you select a category, a page opens with all ads from that category. On the left (on desktop) or in a modal (on mobile) you can apply filters: subcategory, country, region, price, condition, brand, etc. For the "Real estate" category, a map with ad locations is displayed. Click an ad to view details.
guide_ad_page: On the ad page you see photos (click to enlarge), title, price, characteristics and seller info. The "Call" button shows the phone number. The "Write" button opens a chat with the seller. You can add the ad to favorites (heart). At the bottom, "Similar ads" from the same category are shown. The "Share" icon in the top right allows sharing the link.
guide_profile: In your profile you manage your ads. "Current ads" — active ads. "Archive" — hidden ads. "Favorites" — saved ads. Next to each ad: three-dot icon for archive, delete or promote. You can edit your profile (name, photo, link) and settings.
guide_add_ad: Click "Add ad" (plus sign) in the navigation. Select category and subcategory. Fill in required fields: title, price, location, description, photos. Some categories have additional fields (e.g. brand, year for cars). Add at least one photo. Click "Publish" to post your ad.
guide_messages: In the "Messages" section you see a list of all conversations. Unread messages are marked with a count badge on the avatar and bold text. Click a conversation to open it. You can send text and photos. Long press or right-click on a message for "Reply" or "Forward". At the top of the chat, the ad being discussed is shown — click to open the ad.
guide_seller: Clicking the seller's name on the ad page opens their profile. You see all their ads, reviews from other buyers, and the option to send a message. This helps you assess the seller's reliability before buying.
guide_settings: In settings you can change email, password and other account data. Settings are available from your profile dropdown menu in the navigation.
